title: Evaluator children receive the project's Engram MCP server, so "call no other tracker tool" is only a prompt rule
outcome:
Found by the design explorer for w-1ec7bb8b9caa (delegation-0734a86c, read at 28e9ed5). Evaluator mode does not exclude the project's Engram MCP server from the child:
- project lookup follows the parent delegation (src/engram_host_adapter.rs:3059);
- the MCP configuration has no evaluator exclusion (src/engram_mcp_config.rs:565);
- Codex also keeps seeded MCP servers (src/delegation_mcp.rs:534).
So the brief's "Call no other tracker tool" (src/acceptance_evaluation.rs:556-558) is a prompt instruction, not an absence of access. An evaluator could read the tracker beyond its brief, or write to it under its own session: notes, evaluations on other items.
Wanted: an evaluator child's tools are the TermAl evaluator tools only. A tracker call that writes is refused by construction, and any tracker read it needs goes through a host tool scoped to the item it evaluates.
This was split out of w-1ec7bb8b9caa, whose brief fix doesn't depend on it.
acceptance: A guessed tracker write from an evaluator child is refused on every path this change controls: for Claude its read-only gate denies the tracker tool and its checked Bash denies an `engram` command; for Codex the child has no tracker server; a test shows each. The Codex shell path is open on Windows until TermAl w-4b1e11b6bfdc lands, and the item's notes say so.
An evaluation still records end to end with that configuration; the existing acceptance tests pass.

An evaluator child's tool configuration contains no tracker server for Claude and for Codex: none installed by the host, and for Codex none seeded from the user's configuration; a test asserts it for each runtime, and that a reviewer child and an ordinary session of the same project keep the host's tracker server.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and diff hash cited in a note.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect2 batch a640e340, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The host evaluator configuration removes tracker MCP access, landed in 39dd3749 (ancestor of master); src/delegation_mcp.rs:551-556 and src/tests/evaluator_tool_access.rs:128. Closed by evidence; no formal acceptance evaluation was run.
